home.title: The Istaravshan school portal
home.lead: The class register, the timetable, marks and attendance — in one place, for the teacher, the pupil and the parent.

journal.title: The register stays a register
journal.body: The same shape as the Tajik class journal: dates across the top, names down the left, and one square that takes a mark or a letter.

parents.title: Parents are not left guessing
parents.body: A child's attendance and marks are known the same day, not at the end of the term.

official.title: Records stay where they belong
official.body: Everyone sees what they should see and nothing else. The database decides that, not the page.

grades.title: Marks and statistics
grades.body: A rating in percent and points, by subject and by term.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.body: The class's week, the teacher's week and cover, in one place.

news.title: News and notices
news.body: Photographs, comments, and naming a pupil by their nickname.

languages.title: Three languages
languages.body: Tajik, Russian and English — completely, not halfway.

people.title: Import from Excel
people.body: Pupils, teachers and the timetable from a workbook, with logins issued.

home.aboutTitle: About the system, and about us
home.aboutBody: This portal was built for the schools of Istaravshan. The aim is one thing: that the work done today in a paper book and in WhatsApp groups should be done in one orderly, dependable place — without asking a teacher to do the same work twice.
home.startBody: The school office issues your login and password. Enter them on the sign-in page.
